answer: Propose relay listings for sparrow audio from mesa and jetty sensors. Each ID must deliver 1 Mbit/s of requested, globally distinct encrypted chunks during simultaneous 60-second daily audits of all IDs. Independent receivers check sensor hashes and sign ID-bound byte counts; validators reject reuse and suspend failing IDs. Ten IDs need 10 x 1 = 10 Mbit/s despite pooled servers or parallel streams. Hardware is reusable capital; bandwidth and power recur; no stake. Audits prove only sampled delivery; colluding receivers can lie, and spare capacity can make added expense small.
